_comment: US-337: Tool manifest for Ralph deferred tool loading. Core tools are always loaded; deferred tools are discoverable via ToolSearch. US-339: code_execution marker indicates programmatic tool calling support.

_programmatic_tools_v1._comment: US-339: Tool definitions with allowed_callers for programmatic tool calling. When Claude 4.6+ is used, this enables code_execution_20250825 which orchestrates bash_execute, file_read, file_write in sandboxed code.

code_execution.description: Execute orchestrated tool calls from within Python code in a sandboxed environment
